q: The two-sided full shift (Σ_k, σ) on k symbols and the one-sided shift (Σ_k^+, σ^+) have the same topological entropy (log k) but differ in that:
opts: The two-sided shift is invertible (homeomorphism) while the one-sided shift is not invertible
The one-sided shift has more invariant measures
The two-sided shift has fewer periodic points
exp: The two-sided shift is a homeomorphism (σ⁻¹ is the left shift). The one-sided shift σ^+ is not invertible: σ^+(x) = (x₁,x₂,...) drops x₀ and cannot be inverted. The natural extension of the one-sided shift is the two-sided shift.
